purpose: Test an unseen simple transfer where Blender physics owns both the rolling contact outcome and the hinged light-gate pose, while the visible illumination change is caused by that simulated occluder geometry rather than hand placement or light animation.

narrative.cause: a visibly rotating heavy sphere accelerates down a metric ramp under gravity
narrative.contact: the sphere contacts the shutter away from its hinge and transfers momentum
narrative.effect: the Bullet-owned hinged shutter swings open
narrative.reveal: a static warm source illuminates a relief signal only through the physically opened aperture

solverOwnedOutcomesRequired: sphere trajectory and rotation after frame 1

directVisualQuestions: Does the sphere visibly roll under gravity rather than translate like a sliding prop?
Is the sphere-to-shutter contact continuous and spatially believable without a visible gap or deep penetration?
Does the shutter visibly pivot about its modeled hinge and continue with physical inertia rather than jumping to an authored pose?
Does the warm illumination visibly grow because the physical aperture opens, while the lamp itself remains static?
Does the before/contact/reveal sequence communicate one clear cause-and-effect story without explanatory text?
Do the ramp, rails, aperture frame, hinge hardware, shutter ribs and relief receiver read as one intentionally designed place rather than loose primitives?
Do the cameras show sphere rotation, contact direction, hinge pivot and revealed signal without hiding weak physics?
Does native measured motion blur add speed while leaving the contact and moving shutter readable?
Does the final state look physically supported and earned rather than arranged?
visualVerdictRule: PASS only if all nine answers are YES on the three bound stills and full 48-frame clip.

currentAdmissionObservation.effect: preregistration and accepted-binary development may proceed, but no RC2 native source build may start until a read-only admission passes

stopRule: Retain and stop on any authored post-release actor pose, authored post-contact shutter pose, animated lamp, fake reveal, missing Bullet roll/contact/hinge response, weak luminance causality, regression, save/reopen mismatch, resource overrun or direct visual NO. Do not repair a formal result by moving the actor, shutter, lamp, camera or final pose after observing it.
claimCeiling: A PASS would establish one simple rolling-body/hinged-occluder physical-light transfer and a reusable causal film lesson. It would not establish general mechanical simulation, fluid/deformable physics, photorealism, character acting, sound, broad autonomous filmmaking or finished-film quality.
